title: Custom-SQL alert condition: hosts with a promise not kept

expect.truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT hostkey FROM promiseexecutions WHERE promiseoutcome = 'NOTKEPT'
expect.trap_sql: SELECT hostkey FROM promiseexecutions WHERE promiseoutcome = 'NOTKEPT'
expect.trap_note: a host has several not-kept promises, so the obvious query returns more rows than hosts and Mission Portal would overcount failing hosts
